findings.text: follow-on: the red-control log's header names revision 1e9d01f while the command it records collected tests/grammar/test_separatrix_distance_base.py, a file added only at 9968547 and absent at that revision, and it omits the physical_bases sha256 line the suite arms carry, so a reader cannot tell which vocabulary produced the 2-failed result nor reconcile the named revision with the files collected.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 1e9d01f, where 9968547 adds the base entry and the test file, eabe10b adds a trailing newline, and 3bbcf0d and fffa20c add the evidence fragment; no commit touches a path outside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: done_when requires that decomposition and round-trip, a test that fails with the base removed recorded with EXIT=, every other fixture name keeping its parse, the separatrix zone and locus names tested explicitly, and the grammar suite passing at head judged by delta against base; tests/grammar/test_separatrix_distance_base.py:16-42 asserts all of this, and the manifest records logs/negative-control.log (2 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1), logs/full-base-grammar.log:53 (2 failed, 1277 passed, EXIT=1) and logs/full-head-grammar.log:25 (1279 passed, EXIT=0), with zero added failures.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to add a separatrix_distance physical base so that radial_separatrix_distance_at_outboard_midplane decomposes as component radial, base separatrix_distance and position outboard_midplane and round-trips; imas_standard_names/grammar/vocabularies/physical_bases.yml:557 adds the base (kind: scalar, aliases: []) beside decay_length and connection_length, and an independent parse at the reviewed head returns base=separatrix_distance, component=radial, position=outboard_midplane, round-trip true, strict parse ok.
item_verdicts.manifest: the source manifest.md reports status complete and names commits 9968547, eabe10b, 3bbcf0d, fffa20c, the three changed paths, the four test logs, the negative-control log, the two suite arms and the fixture dumps, and states 4 passed, EXIT=0 for the node's own gate.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source brief declares physical_bases.yml, parser.py only if base matching needs it, tests/grammar/test_separatrix_distance_base.py and the landing fragment; git show --stat of the four commits changes only imas_standard_names/grammar/vocabularies/physical_bases.yml, tests/grammar/test_separatrix_distance_base.py and docs/evidence/fragments/concept-and-notation-registry/isn-separatrix-distance.html, so parser.py is untouched and every changed path is inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: the two target tests fail on removal of the base as logs/negative-control.log:15 records (2 failed, EXIT=1) and would redden if separatrix_distance left v.bases, while the fixtures-unchanged clause rests on a one-off dump (logs/fixtures-base.json against logs/fixtures-head.json) rather than a committed guard.
justifications.evidence: tests/grammar/ was run in two scratch trees whose logs (logs/full-base-grammar.log:53 2 failed and 1277 passed, logs/full-head-grammar.log:25 1279 passed) carry EXIT lines and vocabulary digests, and the node's own gate log logs/node-tests-head.log records 4 passed EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: the entry at physical_bases.yml:557 matches the surrounding decay_length and connection_length shape (aliases: [], kind: scalar) and its comment states the mechanism, and the test module carries no plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_standard_names/grammar/vocabularies/physical_bases.yml:557 adds separatrix_distance and an independent parse at the reviewed head returns base=separatrix_distance, component=radial, position=outboard_midplane, round-trip true and strict parse ok.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no function, class or module, extending instead the closed physical-bases vocabulary owned by imas_standard_names/grammar/vocabularies/physical_bases.yml:554, and a search of the grammar vocabulary found no existing distance-from-separatrix base or alias.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 1e9d01f..fffa20c changes only physical_bases.yml, tests/grammar/test_separatrix_distance_base.py and the landing fragment, all inside the declared write paths, with parser.py left untouched as the brief permits.
